opportunities.name: JetBlue flight search sorted by price
opportunities.description: Search JetBlue flights from {origin} to {destination} for {trip_type} on {depart_date}/{return_date}, optionally in points, then sort results by price low to high.
steps: Open jetblue.com Flights tab
Type origin in From and pick the airport/city-area suggestion
Type destination in To and pick the suggestion
Set trip type (Roundtrip/One-way) if needed
Pick depart date (and return date for roundtrip) in calendar
Optionally check 'Use TrueBlue points' or switch results to Points
Click Search flights and 'Continue to flight results' on the interstitial
Open Sort & Filter, set Sort to Price (low to high / by Core), click Apply
Review the cheapest flights / open Details

instances.values: New York (JFK) -> Miami (MIA), roundtrip Mar 27-Mar 31, switched to Points, sort Price by Core
New York City area (NYC) -> Toronto (YYZ), one-way Apr 29, dollars, sort Price low to high
New York City area (NYC) -> Aruba (AUA), roundtrip May 1-May 5, Use TrueBlue points, sort Price low to high

opportunities.name: United car rental search
opportunities.description: Search rental cars on united.com for pickup at {location} from {pickup_date} to {dropoff_date} with optional pickup/drop-off times and Book with miles.
steps: On united.com Book panel click the CAR tab
Optionally toggle 'Book with miles'
Type the pickup location and select the matching suggestion
Open Pickup date picker, click pickup date then drop-off date
Optionally set Pickup time and Drop off time dropdowns
Click Find cars

instances.values: Caldwell (Ohio), US; Apr 8-Apr 13; 8:00 a.m. pickup, 12:00 p.m. drop-off; Book with miles on
Brooklyn - Central (New York), US; Apr 9-Apr 15; default 10:00 a.m. times; miles off

opportunities.name: Avis Budget Group job openings search with filters
opportunities.description: From the Budget site footer go to Careers > Openings and filter jobs by {country}, {team} and {time_type}, then search (and optionally open a job and apply).
steps: Click Careers in the Budget footer
Click Openings
Open Country filter, search and select the country
Open Team filter, select the team
Open Time Type filter, select the time type
Click SEARCH BY JOB TITLE OR KEYWORD
Optionally open a listing and click APPLY NOW

instances.values: United States of America, Finance, Full time; opened Accounts Payable Associate and clicked Apply Now
United States of America, Finance, Full time; search only

opportunities.name: MTA bridge & tunnel toll rate lookup by vehicle
opportunities.description: Navigate new.mta.info to Bridges & Tunnels toll rates and open the toll page for {vehicle_type}.
steps: Open new.mta.info
Navigate to Bridges & Tunnels tolls (Menu > Agencies > Bridges & Tunnels, or Fares & Tolls > Bridges and Tunnels tolls)
Open Tolls by vehicle / Toll Rates
Click the vehicle type (Cars, Motorcycles, Trucks)
Read the rates for the crossing of interest

opportunities.name: NPS Find a Park by activity or topic
opportunities.description: On nps.gov open Find a Park > Search by Activity or Topic, select {activity} or {topic} values, and run the search.
steps: Click FIND A PARK
Click 'Search by Activity or Topic'
Open the Activity or Topic dropdown
Check the desired option(s)
Click Search

opportunities.name: Retail product search with max price and add to cart
opportunities.description: On a retailer site search for {query}, apply a maximum price of {max_price}, pick a matching product, and add it to the cart.
steps: Type the query in the site search box and submit
Enter the maximum price in the Price filter and click Go
Optionally apply an extra attribute filter (e.g., Active Noise Cancellation)
Open or choose a product from results
Click Add to Cart
